screening_results.reason: This is a consensus/working-group report on LATE (pathology-based entity), not a primary neuroimaging study using VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET whole-brain analysis, and it does not include clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients. Exclusion criteria met: E3 (study does not use neuroimaging as defined). Inclusion criteria met: none. Inclusion criteria not met/not demonstrated: I1 (no VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain imaging), I2 (no sample of ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients).

EXCLUDED: This paper is a systematic/narrative review and consensus recommendations (E1). The abstract does not report original neuroimaging analyses using VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET (I1 not met) nor a sample of ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (I2 not met/demonstrated).

Excluded because the article is a review/meta-analysis (E1). No original imaging cohort data are reported: inclusion I1 (use of VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain) not demonstrated and I2 (≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients) not demonstrated. Focus is broad dementia imaging, not specific bvFTD cohort.

No primary study data reported in abstract. Exclusion IDs met: none. Inclusion IDs met: none. Inclusion IDs not met/not demonstrated: I1 (no evidence the study used VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET as a whole-brain analytic modality) and I2 (no report of >=6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients). The abstract appears to be a narrative review of neuroimaging in dementia rather than an original imaging study.

Article is a general review of neuroimaging in dementia (review article), not an original study. Exclusion criteria met: E1 (systematic review/narrative review). Inclusion criteria not demonstrated: I1 (no VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET whole-brain analyses reported), I2 (no sample of ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients). No inclusion criteria are satisfied.

Abstract reports use of voxel-based morphometry (VBM) and includes an autopsy-confirmed/biomarker-negative behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) comparison group (n=59). Not a review/meta-analysis. Both imaging and bvFTD participant criteria are met; include for full-text review to extract details.

E1: The abstract describes a short review of FTD (review article), not original research. Inclusion criteria met: none. Inclusion criteria not met/not demonstrated: I1 (no VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain imaging reported) and I2 (no sample of ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients reported).

Excluded because the article is a review/narrative overview (E1). No original primary data are reported: inclusion criterion I1 (use of VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET whole-brain analyses) is not demonstrated, and I2 (>=6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients) is not demonstrated.

E1: This is a review article. The abstract indicates a review of multimodality imaging in dementias and does not report original VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain analyses or the number of bvFTD participants. Inclusion criteria I1 and I2 are not demonstrated.

Abstract is a narrative review of neuroimaging in FTD (systematic review/meta-analysis excluded by E1). It does not report an original VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain study with participant numbers; I1 and I2 are not demonstrated. No other exclusion criteria apply.

Excluded because inclusion criteria not met: I1 (use of VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET whole-brain) not demonstrated; I2 (sample including ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients) not demonstrated. No exclusion criteria are clearly met (exclusion_criteria_applied: []). Abstract is a narrative review focused on Alzheimer’s disease, not primary empirical bvFTD neuroimaging.

Excluded because this study is a meta-analysis/systematic review (E1). The abstract reports an ALE meta-analysis across imaging modalities including structural MRI (VBM), PET, and fMRI (I1 met) and includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD studies (I2 met). No inclusion criteria remain unmet or not demonstrated.

Abstract clearly studies behavioural variant FTD patients (bvFTD). Imaging used is dual-phase [18F]florbetapir PET; this is not clearly FDG-PET (early-phase is described as FDG-'like'), so I1 is not clearly satisfied from the abstract. No exclusion criteria met. Include for full-text review to confirm imaging modality and participant details.

This is a review of semantic dementia (SD), not a primary imaging study of behavioral variant FTD. Exclusion IDs met: none clearly. Inclusion criteria met: none. Inclusion criteria not met: I2 (no bvFTD patients); I1 not demonstrated (not a primary whole-brain VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET study).

Excluded because the study compares Alzheimer's disease and semantic dementia, not behavioral variant FTD. Exclusion criteria met: none. Inclusion criteria met: none clearly demonstrated. Inclusion criteria not met/not demonstrated: I2 (≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients) is not met — no bvFTD participants reported; I1 (use of VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET whole-brain) is not clearly demonstrated — abstract mentions atrophy and hypometabolism but does not specify VBM or FDG-PET.

E1 met: abstract repeatedly states this is a review ('This review will cover...', 'This review describes...'), so it is a review/meta-analytic-type article. Inclusion criteria met: none. Inclusion criteria not met/not demonstrated: I1 (no original VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain analyses reported), I2 (no participant sample or at least 6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients reported).

Excluded because the study used structural MRI visual ratings rather than VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET, so inclusion criterion I1 is not met. The sample included 71 bvFTD patients (I2 met). No exclusion criteria apply (not a review, not Parkinson's-focused, includes neuroimaging, and has >6 participants).

The abstract reports voxel-based morphometry (VBM) neuroanatomical analyses and includes clinically diagnosed behavioural variant FTD (bvFTD) patients (n=19). It is an original research study, not a review/meta-analysis. Both inclusion criteria I1 and I2 are met; no exclusion criteria apply.

Exclusion E3 met: abstract is a narrative review and does not report any neuroimaging data. No inclusion criteria are met. Specifically, I1 (use of VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET whole-brain) is not demonstrated, and I2 (≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients) is not demonstrated.

Abstract explicitly reports use of voxel-based morphometry (VBM) and includes a large sample of clinically-diagnosed bvFTD patients. Not a review/meta-analysis. Fits both inclusion criteria (I1, I2); no exclusion criteria met.

Abstract is incomplete and only mentions a tau PET ligand; it does not specify use of VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET (I1 not demonstrated) nor state that participants were clinically diagnosed bvFTD (I2 not demonstrated). Not a review/meta-analysis. Inclusion status is uncertain from abstract-only evidence, so include for full-text review.

This is a narrative review (E1). Inclusion criteria met: none. Inclusion criteria not demonstrated: I1 (no primary VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain neuroimaging study reported) and I2 (no sample of ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients).

Excluded (E3): Abstract describes an observational behavioral study of conversational laughter with no neuroimaging mentioned. Inclusion criteria: I1 (VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain) not met; I2 (≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients) not demonstrated (bvFTD cases present but sample size for bvFTD not specified).

Abstract includes bvFTD participants and reports structural MRI analyses, but does not specify use of VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET (I1 not demonstrated) nor report the number of bvFTD patients to confirm at least 6 participants (I2 not demonstrated). No exclusion criteria appear met. Insufficient information to confirm required imaging modality and sample size—include for full-text review.

E1: The abstract explicitly states this article is a systematic review. Inclusion criteria met: none. Inclusion criteria not met/not demonstrated: I1 (no primary VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain imaging study reported), I2 (no report of ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients; review-level paper).

Excluded because I1 not met: imaging modalities were 11C-PK-11195 and 18F-AV-1451 PET (microglial and protein-aggregation tracers), not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET. Inclusion I2 (bvFTD participants included) is met. No exclusion criteria (E1) apply.

E1 met: article is a review. Inclusion criteria met: none. Inclusion criteria not demonstrated: I1 (no evidence of VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain imaging) and I2 (no evidence of ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients).

Abstract addresses predementia bvFTD and mentions morphological and functional neuroimaging but does not specify whether VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET were used, nor clearly state that clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients were included. Insufficient detail to confirm inclusion criteria from abstract alone — include for full-text review.

Abstract includes clinically diagnosed behavioral variant FTD patients (I2). Imaging modality not clearly one of VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET: mentions magnetic/resonance imaging, volumes, and cortical thickness but does not specify VBM. Insufficient modal detail to confirm I1, so include for full-text review.

Abstract reports MRI-based biomarkers for frontotemporal dementia subtypes, which is relevant, but it does not specify use of VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET nor the number of clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants. Insufficient information to confirm inclusion criteria, so include for full-text review.

Imaging modality is diffusion tensor imaging (DTI), which does not meet required modalities (I1 not met). Abstract does not report the number of bvFTD participants, so I2 is not demonstrated. No exclusion criteria (E1–E4) are met.

Abstract is clearly about bvFTD and brain network centrality, but it does not specify the imaging modality (VBM, fMRI, or FDG‐PET) nor report the number of bvFTD participants. No exclusion criteria are met from the abstract. Insufficient information to confirm I1 and I2, so include for full-text review.

Abstract reports voxel-based morphometry (VBM) neuroanatomical analysis and a sample of clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (n=20). It is not a review/meta-analysis. Both inclusion criteria I1 and I2 are clearly satisfied; no exclusion criteria met. Full-text review warranted.

Excluded because the study uses magnetic resonance elastography (MRE), not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET, so inclusion criterion I1 is not met. The abstract does not report the number of bvFTD patients (I2 not demonstrated). No exclusion criteria (E1-E4) are clearly met.

Abstract does not describe use of neuroimaging modalities (E3). No inclusion criteria are satisfied: I1 (neuroimaging VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain) not demonstrated, I2 (≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients) not demonstrated.

Task-based fMRI with whole-brain statistical mapping reported; cohort included 17 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (>=6). No exclusion criteria met (not a review, not PD-focused, uses neuroimaging, sample size sufficient).

Exclusion IDs met: none (E1 not applicable). Inclusion IDs met: none. Inclusion IDs not met/demonstrated: I1 (no VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET — study used TMS), I2 (no bvFTD patients — only healthy subjects reported). Excluding based on abstract-only evidence.

Excluded because E3: abstract reports saccadic eye-movement study with no neuroimaging. Inclusion criteria met: none. Inclusion criteria not met/not demonstrated: I1 (no VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain imaging reported), I2 (abstract does not state inclusion of ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients or specify bvFTD).

Excluded (E3): abstract describes clinical/survival comparison of ALS-FTD vs bvFTD but does not mention any neuroimaging. Inclusion I1 (VBM/fMRI/FDG‑PET whole‑brain imaging) is not met; I2 (≥6 bvFTD participants) is not demonstrated.

Abstract reports MRI-based cerebellar gray matter changes in FTD subtypes (including bvFTD) but does not explicitly state the imaging method is VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET nor explicitly confirm clinically diagnosed bvFTD cases. Not a review. Insufficient detail—include for full-text review.

Abstract addresses bvFTD but does not specify imaging modality (VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET) or report sample size. No exclusion criteria are clearly met. Insufficient information to determine inclusion based on imaging and sample-size criteria, so include for full-text review to verify I1 and I2.

E1 applies: the abstract is a review article (narrative review/meta-review). Inclusion criteria not met/not demonstrated: I1 (no evidence of original whole-brain VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET analyses on subjects), I2 (no report of ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients). Inclusion criteria applied: none.

Excluded because E3: abstract reports clinical assessment and instruments to distinguish bvFTD without mentioning neuroimaging. Inclusion criteria met: none. Inclusion criteria not met/demonstrated: I1 (no VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET), I2 (number of bvFTD participants not reported/not shown >=6).

No mention of behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) patients in abstract. Exclusion criteria met: none. Inclusion criteria met: I1 (FDG-PET used). Inclusion criteria not met/not demonstrated: I2 (at least 6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients not reported).

Abstract discusses empathy in bvFTD but does not report using VBM, fMRI, or FDG‑PET and does not explicitly state that clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients were sampled. It is not a systematic review. Insufficient information to determine imaging modality or sample—include for full-text review.

Abstract reports imaging findings in a group of FTD patients but does not specify imaging modality (VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET), bvFTD subgroup status, or sample size. Key inclusion criteria (I1, I2) cannot be confirmed from the abstract, so include for full-text review.

Abstract reports voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analysis and includes clinically diagnosed behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia patients (bvFTD constituting 71% of the FTLD cohort). The study is original research (not a review). Both inclusion criteria I1 and I2 are satisfied; no exclusion criteria met.

E1 not met. Inclusion I2 met: includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (70 bvFTD). Inclusion I1 NOT met: imaging modality is diffusion-weighted MRI/cortical mean diffusivity and cortical thickness (surface-based), not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET. Therefore exclude.

VBM was used to assess neuroanatomical associations (I1 satisfied). The abstract reports 37 FTD patients and mentions a 'behavioural' group (likely bvFTD) but does not state the number of bvFTD patients, so I2 (>=6 bvFTD) cannot be confirmed from the abstract. No exclusion criteria are met. Include for full-text review to verify bvFTD sample size.

Exclusion E3 met: study reports genetic analyses, not neuroimaging. Inclusion criteria met: none. Inclusion criteria not met/not demonstrated: I1 (no VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET reported), I2 (no evidence of ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients; bvFTD mentioned only in a family case).

Exclusion ID met: E3 (study reports plasma tau biomarker, no neuroimaging mentioned). Inclusion IDs met: none. Inclusion IDs not met/not demonstrated: I1 (no VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain imaging), I2 (no evidence of ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants).

Abstract is truncated and does not specify imaging modality (VBM, fMRI, FDG-PET) nor whether participants are clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients. It is not a systematic review. Because key inclusion criteria cannot be confirmed from the abstract, include for full-text review to determine eligibility.

Abstract reports use of voxel-based morphometry (VBM) and includes 25 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients, satisfying I1 and I2. No exclusion criteria are met: not a review, not focused on Parkinson's, uses neuroimaging, and has >=6 participants. Recommend inclusion for full-text review.

Abstract explicitly includes behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) participants but does not specify imaging modality (VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET). Not a systematic review. Imaging inclusion criterion I1 not demonstrated; I2 met; E1 not met. Include for full-text review to confirm imaging methods.

This is a meta-analysis (E1) of primary progressive aphasia subtypes, not behavioral variant FTD; no bvFTD participants are reported so I2 is not met. The study uses MRI and FDG-PET consistent with I1, but it focuses on PPA, not bvFTD, therefore excluded.

Included for full-text review. Abstract reports volumetric grey/white-matter analyses and includes behavioural variant FTD patients (n=14 ≥6), satisfying I2. However the abstract does not explicitly state the imaging modality is VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET (I1 not confirmed). No exclusion criteria are met. Full text needed to confirm imaging modality and whole-brain analysis.

Abstract does not provide sufficient information on imaging modality (VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET), whether participants are bvFTD specifically, or sample size (>=6). No exclusion criteria are clearly met. Include for full-text review to determine imaging methods and sample characteristics.

Abstract explicitly examines altered functional connectivity (fMRI) in MAPT mutation carriers and states a comparison to subjects with behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD), indicating inclusion of clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants and use of fMRI. Not a review or meta-analysis.

(a) Exclusion IDs met: E3 (no neuroimaging used), E4 (single-case study, <6 participants). (b) Inclusion IDs met: none. (c) Inclusion IDs not met: I1 (no VBM/fMRI/FDG‑PET whole-brain imaging), I2 (did not include ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients). The abstract describes a single autopsy case of Pick disease with histopathology, so it fails required imaging and sample-size criteria.

Study includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (meets I2). Imaging is described as baseline MRI grey matter atrophy but does not explicitly state VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET (I1 unclear). Not a review/meta-analysis (E1 not met). Because imaging modality is uncertain from abstract, include for full-text review to verify I1.

Abstract does not specify imaging modality (VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET) nor explicitly state that participants are clinically diagnosed bvFTD. It is not a review/meta-analysis. Insufficient information to confirm I1 and I2 from abstract alone—include for full-text review to determine eligibility.

Excluded because exclusion criterion E3 (study does not use neuroimaging) is clearly met — the abstract describes psychiatric evaluation of bvFTD phenocopy without reporting VBM, fMRI, or FDG‑PET. Inclusion criteria: I1 (use of VBM/fMRI/FDG‑PET) not met; I2 (≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients) not demonstrated in abstract. E1 (review) and E2 (Parkinson's focus) are not applicable.

E1 applies: abstract is explicitly a review ('In this review...'), so it is a systematic review/meta-analysis and excluded. Inclusion criteria not met: I1 not demonstrated (no clear use of VBM, fMRI, or FDG‑PET analyzing whole brain), I2 not demonstrated (no report of ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients).

(a) Exclusion IDs met: none (E1 not met). (b) Inclusion IDs met: none. (c) Inclusion IDs not met or not demonstrated: I2 not met — participants are presymptomatic FTD mutation carriers, not clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients; I1 not demonstrated — abstract states 'multimodal MRI' but does not specify VBM, fMRI, or FDG‑PET.

Abstract reports use of voxel-based morphometry (VBM) and includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (64/176). No exclusion criteria apply. Therefore the study meets I1 and I2 and should be included for full-text review.

Abstract mentions neuroimaging correlates of FTLD with SQSTM1 mutations but provides no details on imaging modality (VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET), whether participants are clinically diagnosed bvFTD, or sample size. Exclusion criteria are not clearly met from abstract. Insufficient information for eligibility; full-text review needed to confirm I1 and I2.

No imaging modality reported (VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET) — I1 not met. Abstract studies caregiver burden in FTD/ALS but does not specify clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants — I2 not demonstrated. No exclusion criteria met (not a review). Excluded due to unmet inclusion criteria.

Abstract reports structural and diffusion-tensor MRI in FTLD but does not explicitly state use of VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET, nor does it explicitly state that clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients were included. No exclusion criteria met. Insufficient information to determine inclusion from abstract alone, so include for full-text review.

E1 met: the paper is a meta-analysis. Inclusion criteria met: none. I1 not demonstrated: this is an aggregate meta-analysis and does not itself perform VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain analyses. I2 not demonstrated: abstract does not report number of clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants (subtype counts unclear).

Abstract explicitly reports use of voxel-based morphometry (VBM) and includes clinically diagnosed behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) patients among the cohort. Not a review/meta-analysis. Both inclusion criteria I1 and I2 are met; no exclusion criteria apply.

FDG-PET was used to assess brain metabolism (I1 satisfied). The abstract does not report number of bvFTD patients or confirm clinically diagnosed bvFTD cases (I2 not demonstrated). No exclusion criteria are clearly met from the abstract. Include for full-text review to determine bvFTD sample size and diagnostic details.

Excluded because E4 applies: this is a single-case (n=1) longitudinal study, i.e., fewer than 6 participants. Inclusion I1 is met (FDG-PET whole-brain imaging). Inclusion I2 is NOT met/not demonstrated (does not include ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients).

Abstract reports voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analysis (meets I1) and includes 20 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (meets I2). No exclusion criteria (reviews, Parkinson's focus, lack of neuroimaging, or sample <6) are met. Include for full-text review.

Abstract does not specify use of whole-brain neuroimaging (VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET) nor report number of clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients; it only refers to 'individuals along the FTD spectrum.' No exclusion criteria are clearly met. Because key inclusion criteria (I1 and I2) are not demonstrated in the abstract, include for full-text review to ascertain imaging modality and sample composition.

E4 met: study reports only 2 patients (fewer than 6). Inclusion criteria not met: I2 not met (does not include ≥6 bvFTD patients); I1 not demonstrated (imaging modality not specified as VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET). No inclusion criteria satisfied. The paper also describes temporal variant FTD rather than clearly addressing behavioral variant FTD.

Abstract reports use of voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analyses in a subset of bvFTD patients and includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants. It is an original research imaging study (not a review). Therefore it meets I1 and I2 and no exclusion criteria apply.

Abstract reports voxel-based morphometry (VBM) performed in 91 patients with available imaging and includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (103 identified); not a review/meta-analysis. Both inclusion criteria I1 (VBM) and I2 (bvFTD sample) are satisfied; no exclusion criteria met.

This is an invited review article (meets exclusion E1). It does not report an original neuroimaging study using VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET on at least 6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (I1 and I2 not met).

Abstract explicitly reports use of voxel-based morphometry (VBM) and includes a sample of 19 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients. It is an original empirical study (not a review). Both inclusion criteria I1 and I2 are clearly met from the abstract.

Abstract explicitly reports use of voxel-based morphometry and includes clinically diagnosed behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) patients; not a review. Thus it satisfies I1 and I2 and no exclusion criteria are met.

No imaging modality reported (no VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET). Participants are autopsy-confirmed Pick disease cases and the abstract does not state clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients. Therefore inclusion criteria I1 and I2 are not met. No exclusion criteria (e.g., systematic review) are met.

Focuses on mild behavioral impairment (MBI), not clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients; abstract does not report inclusion of ≥6 bvFTD participants (I2 not met). Imaging described generally as MRI/structural features but does not specify VBM, fMRI, or FDG‑PET whole‑brain analyses (I1 not demonstrated). No exclusion criteria clearly met from abstract.

Abstract addresses bvFTD but gives insufficient details: imaging modality not explicitly stated (though 'functional brain network' implies fMRI) and number of bvFTD participants is not reported. No exclusion criteria are clearly met. Include for full-text review to confirm use of VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET and whether ≥6 bvFTD patients.

Abstract reports measurement of cerebral glucose metabolism (FDG-PET) and explicitly includes 31 clinically diagnosed behavioral variant FTD patients; not a review. Thus I1 and I2 are met and no exclusion criteria apply.

Abstract reports use of voxel-based morphometry (VBM) to measure cortical grey matter atrophy and includes 12 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients, satisfying inclusion criteria I1 and I2. No exclusion criteria are met (not a review, not Parkinson's, uses neuroimaging, and sample size >=6).

Excluded because abstract reports semantic dementia patients undergoing word retraining without any neuroimaging. (a) Exclusion met: E3 (no neuroimaging). (b) Inclusion met: none. (c) Inclusion not met/not demonstrated: I1 (no VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain imaging), I2 (does not include bvFTD patients).

Include for full-text review: abstract explicitly reports voxel-based morphometry (VBM) neuroimaging (I1 satisfied) but does not state the number of behavioural variant FTD (bvFTD) participants, so I2 is not demonstrated from the abstract. No exclusion criteria are clearly met. Full text needed to confirm whether ≥6 bvFTD patients were included.

Abstract reports use of voxel-based morphometry (meets I1) and includes clinically diagnosed behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia patients (56 genetically confirmed bvFTD and 20 sporadic bvFTD; meets I2). Not a review/meta-analysis. Sufficient information in abstract to include for full-text review.

Abstract addresses self-appraisal in behavioural-variant FTD and appears to involve bvFTD patients, but does not specify imaging modality (VBM, fMRI, FDG-PET). No exclusion criteria met. Imaging method is unclear, so include for full-text review to determine I1.

Abstract does not report the imaging modality (VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET) nor explicitly state that clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients were included. Title suggests regional cerebral blood flow measures (unclear modality). No exclusion criteria met. Include for full-text review to determine eligibility.

Abstract does not report behavioral-variant FTD cases nor specify use of VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET. Exclusion IDs met: none. Inclusion IDs met: none. Inclusion IDs not met/not demonstrated: I1 (no evidence of VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain imaging), I2 (no evidence of ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients).

No exclusion criteria met (none of E1–E4 applied). Inclusion met: I2 (20 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients). Inclusion not met: I1 — imaging modality was diffusion tensor imaging (DTI), not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET. Excluded because it fails to satisfy I1.

Study investigates primary progressive aphasia (PPA) variants, not behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD). Imaging modality is task fMRI (I1 met). Inclusion criterion I2 (>=6 bvFTD patients) is not met — no bvFTD participants reported. No exclusion criteria from E1–E4 are triggered.

Excluded because E4 is met: the study reports only two patients (<6). Inclusion criteria met: none. Inclusion criteria not met/not demonstrated: I2 (does not include ≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients) and I1 (no evidence of VBM, fMRI, or FDG‑PET whole‑brain imaging in the abstract).

Abstract reports clinically diagnosed behavioural variant FTD patients (n=22) and assesses structural neuroanatomical correlates using voxel-based morphometry; not a review. Both inclusion criteria I1 and I2 are satisfied.

The abstract reports 28 clinically diagnosed behavioural variant FTD patients (bvFTD) and uses voxel-based morphometry and task-free (resting-state) fMRI. It is an original research study (not a review). Thus inclusion criteria I1 and I2 are met and no exclusion criteria apply.

Abstract and title indicate study of moral judgment and brain structural signatures in frontotemporal dementia, but the abstract does not explicitly state which imaging modality was used (VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET) nor clearly confirm inclusion of clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants. It is not a review. Due to insufficient methodological detail in the abstract, include for full-text review to determine whether I1 and I2 are met.

No exclusion criteria met. Abstract does not report use of VBM, fMRI, or FDG‑PET whole-brain analyses (I1 not met) and does not report any clinically diagnosed bvFTD patient sample of at least 6 participants (I2 not met). Therefore it does not meet the inclusion criteria for this review.

The study reports use of voxel-based morphometry and task-free (resting-state) fMRI (meets I1) and includes 23 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (meets I2). No exclusion criteria are met from the abstract.

Abstract provides insufficient information to determine presence of clinically diagnosed bvFTD sample, imaging modality (VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET), or sample size. No exclusion criteria are clearly met from the abstract. Include for full-text review to assess imaging methods and participant details.

Includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (I2 met). Abstract does not specify use of VBM, fMRI, or FDG‑PET (I1 not demonstrated). Not a systematic review (E1 not met). Imaging modality is unclear from abstract, so include for full-text review to determine I1.

Abstract reports use of voxel-based morphometry (VBM) and includes clinically diagnosed behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia patients; not a review/meta-analysis. Both inclusion criteria I1 and I2 are satisfied.

Abstract addresses a right temporal variant of FTD (relevant to bvFTD topic) but does not specify use of VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET, nor report the number of clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients. Inclusion criteria (I1, I2) are not demonstrably met from the abstract alone; exclusion criteria are not clearly met. Include for full-text review to determine imaging modality and sample details.

Abstract addresses eating behavior disturbances in FTD but does not specify imaging modality (VBM, fMRI, FDG-PET) nor confirm inclusion of clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients. No exclusion criteria met. Abstract provides insufficient information to determine inclusion, so include for full-text review.

Abstract reports a volumetric MRI study of FTD with behavioural changes suggesting bvFTD, but does not specify use of VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET, the number of bvFTD participants, or explicit bvFTD diagnostic labeling. Inclusion criteria are therefore not demonstrated from the abstract alone; full-text review needed to determine eligibility.

Excluded because the abstract does not report any neuroimaging methods (E3). No inclusion criteria were met: I1 (VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain imaging) is not demonstrated; I2 (≥6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients) is not reported in the abstract.

EXCLUDED because inclusion criteria not met: I1 not satisfied (study reports structural MRI atrophy, not VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET) and I2 not satisfied (participants have temporal variant FTD, not clinically diagnosed bvFTD). No exclusion criteria met (E1 []).

E3 met: abstract describes a behavioral/informant scale study without neuroimaging. Inclusion criteria met: none. Inclusion criteria not met/not demonstrated: I1 (no VBM/fMRI/FDG-PET whole-brain imaging reported), I2 (number of bvFTD patients ≥6 not reported in abstract).

Excluded: E4 (sample size <6; single patient). Inclusion criteria met: none. Inclusion criteria not met: I1 not met — used structural MRI only, not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET whole-brain analyses; I2 not met — fewer than 6 clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients.
